claims.text: Introduces an early return in the Sentry endpoint when total_baseline <= 0
In that early return case, the endpoint returns a 200 OK response with an empty rankedAttributes list
The response shape now consistently includes rankingInfo, cohort1Total, and cohort2Total even in the early return case
This avoids unnecessary calls to the Seer service when no meaningful comparison can be made

stated_scope: This change introduces an early return in the Sentry endpoint so that when total_baseline <= 0, it returns a 200 OK response with an empty rankedAttributes list while keeping the response shape consistent, preventing 500 errors and avoiding unnecessary Seer service calls.
